title.narrative: Fundación Fondo de Mujeres del Sur

description.narrative: Fondo de Mujeres del Sur mobilizes resources and provides grants and support to grassroots groups defending the rights of women and LBTIQ+ people in Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay. Since 2017, it also coordinates Leading from the South, an extensive regional grantmaking program in Latin America and the Caribbean. Its priority grantmaking strategies focus on the following themes: leadership, agency and political participation; economic justice; eradication of violence and discrimination; socio-environmental justice; and diverse identities and sexualities.
